whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Adhvik Dental Hospital,

I noticed your clinic has built an amazing 5.0★ reputation in Kankarbagh, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for online appointment bookings.

Maine aapke dental hospital ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, treatments showcase, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/adhvik

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Adhvik Dental Hospital team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke hospital ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and patient care highlights for your practice in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
